name: ANSI/IEEE permanent-magnet dc motor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for permanent-magnet dc motor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The permanent-magnet DC motor form identifies a machine using a permanent magnetic field. Its electrical drawing focuses on armature and control connections while mechanical motor data establishes the driven application and rating.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Do not add a separate field-supply circuit unless the actual machine requires it.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Permanent-magnet excitation differs from a separately excited electrical field winding.
